blocks.text: The IA half of AI / IA

Purview DC is where the group’s infrastructure story lives: the GPU floors, networks and facilities that intelligent applications run on. It gives Purview’s AI practice an installation and operations partner under the same roof, and gives hyperscalers, neoclouds and sovereign programmes one accountable team from purchase order to steady state.

items.title: Facility design and build
items.body: Site selection, power and cooling design, modular and containerised builds, fit-out and handover.

items.title: GPU floor installation
items.body: HGX, B200, B300 and GB300 racks received, staged, installed and cabled to OEM standard.

items.title: Structured cabling
items.body: Copper and fibre, certified and documented, from meet-me room to rack.

items.title: Networks
items.body: Spine-leaf, InfiniBand and Ethernet fabrics, out-of-band and security, configured and validated.

items.title: Commissioning and validation
items.body: Power-on, burn-in, cluster validation and acceptance evidence, before go-live.

items.title: 24×7 operations
items.body: Smart hands, monitoring, incident and change management against signed SLAs.

blocks.text: Preparation first, six phases, four quality gates

items.title: Prepare
items.body: Scope, drawings, bill of materials and method statements agreed before anything ships; the pre-staging that removes surprises on the floor.

items.title: Receive and stage
items.body: Dock-to-rack logistics, asset tagging and pre-staging in Purview’s integration facility or on site.

items.title: Install
items.body: Racks, power, cabling and network fabric installed by certified lead engineers with technician teams under them.

items.title: Commission
items.body: Power-on, burn-in and cluster validation, with every result captured as acceptance evidence.

items.title: Operate
items.body: Handover into 24×7 operations, or to the client’s own team with documentation and training.

items.title: Four delivery platforms built on live projects
items.body: Data Center Deployer runs dock-to-rack delivery with a technician app and coordinator control tower; SmartInspect brings wearable-led remote inspection and audit; SmartAMM monitors assets from sensor to digital twin; SmartWorkforce turns SOPs into device-ready guidance for engineers.
